name: Oppaidius: Desert Island!
source:
After a dramatic shipwreck, you end up on a island with Angela, an incredible girl! Now you two are stuck together on a desert island! What will happen...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1345340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一场惊险的海难过后，你与魅力十足的女孩安吉拉流落到了一座岛上！如今，两人一起被困在这座荒岛。接下来会发生什么呢……？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1345340/]Steam[/url]]
